nodes.name: Every 15 minutes
nodes.notes: n8n is the sole scheduler. This is a deterministic reconciliation request, not an agent trigger. Unchanged state spends zero model tokens.

nodes.name: Igor: reconcile Hall catalog
nodes.notes: Verify internal Igor URL and n8n environment credentials before activation. Requires X-API-Key plus X-N8N-Secret. Acceptance means every delivered event was mirrored and index work was durably queued; it does not mean extraction completed. The source cursor advances only after queue acceptance. Full manifest reconciliation repairs catalog drift and missed archive/revoke changes. The endpoint starts a background queue drain; the existing hourly task_queue_drain workflow handles later retries. No /trigger call or assistant message is needed.
